claims.claim: President Lee Jae Myung on Sunday called for a thorough investigation into hacking attacks that leaked personal information at major banks and other financial institutions.
claims.episode_span: President Lee Jae Myung on Sunday called for a thorough investigation
claims.source_title: Lee calls for thorough probe into personal data leaks at financial institutions
claims.supporting_quote: President Lee Jae Myung on Sunday called for a thorough investigation into a series of hacking attacks that caused personal information leaks at major banks and other financial institutions.

claims.claim: Presidential spokesperson Kang Yu-jung said Lee was briefed on breaches at financial and public institutions and instructed authorities to investigate thoroughly and spare no effort on measures.
claims.episode_span: She said he was briefed on breaches at financial and public institutions
claims.source_title: Lee calls for thorough probe into personal data leaks at financial institutions
claims.supporting_quote: He instructed authorities to take the matter seriously, conduct a thorough investigation and spare no effort in coming up with measures to address the issue,

claims.claim: Shinhan Bank said personal information of around 25,000 customers, including names, phone numbers and annual income, had been leaked.
claims.source_title: Lee calls for thorough probe into personal data leaks at financial institutions
claims.supporting_quote: Shinhan Bank said personal information of around 25,000 customers, including their names, phone numbers and annual income, had been leaked.

claims.claim: Sources said Shinhan Bank was attacked by hackers who utilized advanced AI tools.
claims.episode_span: sources told Yonhap the attackers used advanced artificial intelligence tools
claims.source_title: Lee calls for thorough probe into personal data leaks at financial institutions
claims.supporting_quote: Sources said the bank was attacked by hackers who utilized advanced artificial intelligence (AI) tools.

claims.claim: Personal information of 89 Hana Bank customers was leaked, while Woori Bank and NH Nonghyup Bank blocked unauthorized access and reported no leak.
claims.episode_span: Personal information of 89 Hana Bank customers was leaked
claims.source_title: Lee calls for thorough probe into personal data leaks at financial institutions
claims.supporting_quote: Personal information of 89 customers was found to have been leaked from Hana Bank, while Woori Bank and NH Nonghyup Bank were also targeted in similar hacking attempts, though no personal information was leaked as the banks blocked unauthorized access to their systems.

claims.claim: FSC Chairman Lee Eog-weon said no sensitive information that could be used for unauthorized payments appeared to have been leaked, but warned leaked information could be exploited for voice phishing or other scams, and did not rule out AI tools.
claims.episode_span: information usable for unauthorized payments did not appear to have leaked
claims.source_title: Lee calls for thorough probe into personal data leaks at financial institutions
claims.supporting_quote: He said no sensitive information that could be used for unauthorized payments appeared to have been leaked so far but urged the financial sector to maintain the "highest level of vigilance," warning that the leaked information could still be exploited for voice phishing or other scams.

claims.claim: India raised the deepwater gas price ceiling to 9.89 dollars per MMBtu from 8.90, kept APM gas capped at 7 dollars, and allowed new ONGC and OIL wells up to 7.70 dollars.
claims.episode_span: India raised the deepwater gas price ceiling to 9.89 dollars
claims.source_title: India Raises Deepwater Gas Price to $9.89; APM Capped at $7
claims.supporting_quote: India raised the deepwater gas price ceiling to USD 9.89/MMBtu, up from USD 8.90.

claims.claim: Philippine authorities arrested 244 foreign workers and said it was the largest crackdown on illegal online gaming operators this year.
claims.source_title: Philippines arrests 244 foreign workers in online scam crackdown
claims.supporting_quote: Authorities say that this is the Philippines' largest crackdown on illegal online gaming operators this year

claims.claim: Two unidentified people on a motorbike shot Mad Sandhu dead on Loharka road in Amritsar at about 6 p.m. Saturday.
claims.episode_span: shot makeup artist and influencer Mad Sandhu
claims.source_title: Punjabi influencer, makeup artist shot dead in Amritsar
claims.supporting_quote: Two unidentified persons, who were on a motorbike, opened fire at Mad Sandhu and fled the spot, Additional Deputy Commissioner of Police Sirivennela said.

claims.claim: Pakistan's Foreign Ministry accused Indian security forces of using unprovoked lethal force against unarmed civilians after the BSF killed two people.

claims.supporting_quote: Pakistan’s Foreign Ministry accused the Indian security forces of using “unprovoked lethal force against unarmed civilians”

claims.source_title: Shark warning for NSW river after whale carcass removed

claims.claim: Davin Ballard, a 20-year-old U.S. marine at Futenma, was arrested Sunday on suspicion of killing Anna Yagi, 39, and taking her wallet and backpack at a Naha hotel; he denied the charges.
claims.episode_span: Davin Ballard, stationed at Futenma Airbase, was arrested on Sunday
claims.source_title: Japan’s Takaichi presses US after marine arrested over murder-robbery of woman
claims.supporting_quote: Davin Ballard stationed at the Futenma Airbase is suspected of killing Anna Yagi, 39, and taking her wallet and backpack in the early hours of Saturday at a hotel in Naha, according to the Okinawa prefectural police.

claims.claim: Justice B. Pugalendhi of the Madurai Bench said attachment of properties acquired through corrupt means should be made mandatory under the Prevention of Corruption Act.
claims.source_title: Mandatory attachment, confiscation essential to combat vice of corruption, says Madras High Court
claims.supporting_quote: The Court said it was of the view that necessary amendments had to be carried out in the Prevention of Corruption Act, and that the attachment of properties believed to have been obtained through corrupt means, and through wealth disproportionate to known sources of income, had to be made mandatory.

claims.claim: Hong Kong, China athletes won 54 medals at the 20th Asian Games, comprising 11 gold, 19 silver and 24 bronze, from a delegation of some 580 athletes in 38 events.
claims.episode_span: won 54 medals — 11 gold, 19 silver and 24 bronze
claims.source_title: Hong Kong Athletes Shine at Asian Games, Winning Record 54 Medals and Earning Praise from Chief Executive John Lee
claims.supporting_quote: They have won a total of 54 medals, comprising 11 gold medals, 19 silver medals and 24 bronze medals - surpassing previous record for the total number of medals while also securing the most gold medals ever
